name: The EX-orcism
source:
You've been summoned to an abandoned frat house to perform an exorcism. Turns out, the ghost is your ex-boyfriend, and he really, REALLY wants you back. Good luck, you're going to need it...

[Edited from [url=https://barbieronpa.itch.io/the-ex-orcism]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你被召唤到一个废弃的兄弟会房子进行驱魔。事实证明，那个鬼魂是你的前男友，他真的非常想要你回来。祝你好运，你会需要它……

[编辑自[url=https://barbieronpa.itch.io/the-ex-orcism]itch.io[/url]]
